summary: Weekend (Sat 4:30 PM, Sun 8:30 and 10:30 AM) and weekday (Mon-Wed, Fri 8:30 AM) Masses, Thursday 6:30-7:30 PM adoration, and the first-Saturday 9 AM Mass are clear; first-Saturday adoration to the 2:55 PM Benediction has no printed start time. Thursday 8:30 AM is a Communion Service and is left out. Confession has no clock time ('generally an hour before each Mass'), so each confession window is a question about whether it ends at the Mass or 15 minutes before; dated Portuguese Mass (Oct 11) and All Souls Mass (Nov 2) are included.
